head: MS
raw_output: Jessica's health and stress levels progressed over time, with her initially struggling with poor health and taking a step back from work. She experienced overwhelming anxiety, sleep issues, and feelings of disconnection from her work. To manage her stress, she tried meditation and breathing exercises but found them only partially effective. She also considered seeking professional counseling for more structured support. With the help of her supporter, Jessica recognized the importance of taking care of herself and delegating tasks to ease her mind. She began to focus on positive aspects, such as a potential new business partnership, and started to look forward to a new chapter in her life.
